intro: Merpati Meadow is an HDB BTO project in Geylang, listed in the November 2026 BTO exercise with 438 flats, as recorded from HDB’s BTO portal in our project file. The official confirmation covers the launch and that unit count only, not TOP or keys. Our file also notes that the portal has carried inconsistent October and November labels; we treat the exercise as a November 2026 launch as recorded, and we do not treat either label as a completion date. Tenure is left blank. Use your HDB documents for typologies. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Merpati Meadow renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Merpati Meadow interior
sections.text:
A newly launched Geylang BTO is still years from renovation, which is useful. When the official plan is issued, you can brief a designer properly: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall, with a built-in desk if a common bedroom will be a study. Maison specifies that work as built-in carpentry, not as IKEA-style furniture, and we will not invent a typical Merpati Meadow layout because no official floor plan is on file. We can show a full room or a closer study of a wardrobe or a kitchen run when you need to decide on a finish.

MacPherson Weave and Dakota Crest are other Geylang pages in this batch, at an unconfirmed near-completion stage. They are not a guide to when Merpati Meadow will get keys. Grand Dunman, already live in District 15, is a nearby private-housing link only. We will not invent walking times to any MRT station, and we will not guess typologies from the project name.

Keep the official plan when HDB issues it, and write to us when you want the carpentry drawings frozen well before any permit is due. After keys, inspect defects and apply for the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals — an editorial allowance, not a promise. WhatsApp Maison with your unit type and plan when you have them. We are not affiliated with HDB.

faq.a: Our project file records: 2026-11 launch. That official confirmation covers the launch date only, not TOP or key collection.

faq.q: Is the key-collection date for Merpati Meadow confirmed?
faq.a: No. Completion and keys are unconfirmed in our file. Use your HDB documents for your own appointment, when you have one.

faq.q: Do you have the Merpati Meadow floor plan?
faq.a: No official floor-plan or site image is on file for this page, so none is published here. Please send your approved HDB unit plan.

Your approved floor plan, unit type if you have it, and a key date if one is already in writing. After keys, an HDB renovation permit is required before works. WhatsApp us at https://wa.me/6593391185.
